def correct_dots(r):
    """Use the 14th contact to reinforce the four underfilled dots in one continuous path."""
    now=np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam'],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'][7:10],float)
    path=[]
    offset_u,offset_v=12.,15.  # compensate the observed brush lag on short diagonal marks
    for j,(name,pts) in enumerate(MAIN_STROKES[9:13]):
        shifted=[[float(u)+offset_u,float(v)+offset_v,max(2.,float(d))] for u,v,d in pts]
        if j:
            # Stay 2 mm below the paper between separate exemplar dots so this remains one contact.
            path.append([path[-1][0],path[-1][1],2.])
            path.append([shifted[0][0],shifted[0][1],2.])
        path.extend(shifted)
    world=[pixpt(p) for p in path]
    above=world[0].copy();above[2]=.080
    end_above=world[-1].copy();end_above[2]=.080
    rows=[]
    _append_segment(rows,now,above,.15)
    _append_segment(rows,above,world[0],.08)
    for a,b in zip(world[:-1],world[1:]): _append_segment(rows,a,b,.035)
    _append_segment(rows,world[-1],end_above,.08)
    P=np.asarray(rows,dtype=np.float32)
    if len(P)>200: raise RuntimeError(f'dot correction: {len(P)} rows exceeds a safe chunk')
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',P,dt=.05,cameras=['canvas_cam','side_cam'],video='mp4',note='main_dot_correction_14th_contact')
    res.save(os.path.join(OUT,'runs','main_dot_correction_14th_contact'))
    print('dot_correction rows',len(P),'steps',res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'),'stopped',res.stopped,
          'end',np.round(res.meta.get('proprio',{}).get('now',[0]*10)[7:10],5).tolist())
    print('service_status',r.status())
    return res
'''
